name: Kings of Leon

whyMatters.en: Nashville Followill family band formed in 1999. Early albums kept raw Southern garage rock; Only by the Night (2008) reached arena alt-radio, with Sex on Fire and Use Somebody as the crossover singles.
whyMatters.zh: 纳什维尔 Followill 家族乐队，1999 年成立。早期专辑保持毛糙南方 garage 摇滚；《Only by the Night》（2008）进入体育场 alternative 电台，以《Sex on Fire》与《Use Somebody》为跨界单曲。

lyricQuotes: I lay my love on you
You know that I could use somebody

shortBio.en: Followill family alt-rock; Sex on Fire and Use Somebody are the 2008 crossover pair.
shortBio.zh: Followill 家族 alt-rock；《Sex on Fire》与《Use Somebody》是 2008 跨界双曲。

body.en:
Kings of Leon formed in Nashville in 1999—three brothers plus cousin Matthew on lead guitar. Youth & Young Manhood (2003) and Aha Shake Heartbreak (2004) pushed rawer riffs and Caleb’s strained vocal; Because of the Times (2007) expanded delay and dynamics.

Sex on Fire and Use Somebody (both 2008, Only by the Night) are the main chart objects. The path is US Southern garage into stadium indie under polished alt-radio production. The four Followills stayed the constant lineup.

Caleb and Nathan Followill moved from Oklahoma to Nashville in 1997 and played bars as The Followills. Manager Ken Levitan set the RCA deal. Jared, then 16, took bass. Cousin Matthew Followill took guitar. The Holy Roller Novocaine EP is 2002. Youth & Young Manhood is 2003. Aha Shake Heartbreak is 2004. Because of the Times (2007) was their first UK #1. The title is a religious meeting they attended as teenagers. Only by the Night (2008) was another UK #1. Sex on Fire and Use Somebody are the singles. Live at the O2 London is the 2009 DVD. At a Scottish festival that year Caleb snapped at a cold crowd and broke a guitar. Come Around Sundown (2010) was a UK #1 and a US #2. Mechanical Bull is 2013. Listeners often set Matthew’s delay guitar next to U2.
body.zh:
Kings of Leon 于 1999 年在纳什维尔成立——三兄弟加堂兄 Matthew 任 lead 吉他。《Youth & Young Manhood》（2003）与《Aha Shake Heartbreak》（2004）推更毛糙 riff 与 Caleb 绷紧人声；《Because of the Times》（2007）扩展延时与动态。

《Sex on Fire》与《Use Somebody》（均 2008，出自《Only by the Night》）是主要榜单对象。路径是美国南方 garage 进入体育场 indie，制作偏抛光 alt 电台。四名 Followill 为固定阵容。

Caleb 与 Nathan Followill 1997 年从俄克拉荷马搬到纳什维尔，以 The Followills 在酒吧演出。经纪人 Ken Levitan 安排了 RCA 合约。当时 16 岁的 Jared 接贝斯。堂弟 Matthew Followill 接吉他。EP《Holy Roller Novocaine》是 2002 年。《Youth & Young Manhood》是 2003 年。《Aha Shake Heartbreak》是 2004 年。《Because of the Times》（2007）是他们第一张英国冠军。专辑名来自少年时参加的一次宗教聚会。《Only by the Night》（2008）又是英国冠军。《Sex on Fire》与《Use Somebody》是单曲。《Live at the O2 London》是 2009 年的 DVD。同年苏格兰一场音乐节上，Caleb 对冷场发作，并砸了吉他。《Come Around Sundown》（2010）英国冠军、美国第 2。《Mechanical Bull》是 2013 年。听众常把 Matthew 的延时吉他和 U2 放在一起说。

note.zh: 出自《Only by the Night》；延时 lead riff、Caleb 绷紧人声；重要体育场单曲。

note.zh: 钢琴主导谣曲配大混响；同一专辑上的第二支全球摇滚电台热单。

note.en: From Youth & Young Manhood; garage riff and raw vocal before arena polish.
note.zh: 出自《Youth & Young Manhood》；体育场抛光前的 garage riff 与毛人声。

title.zh: 南方 garage 到体育场 alt-rock

body.en:
The catalog moves from rough indie garage to global rock radio with the same four Followills and rising production budgets.

Youth & Young Manhood (2003) and Aha Shake Heartbreak (2004) document Strokes-era rawness with Nashville/Southern rock undertow. Only by the Night (2008) is the commercial pivot: delay guitars, big-room reverb, singalong choruses.

Sex on Fire’s lead riff and Caleb’s falsetto strain are the main crossover moves.
body.zh:
目录从毛糙 indie garage 走到全球摇滚电台，同一批 Followill，制作预算上升。

《Youth & Young Manhood》（2003）与《Aha Shake Heartbreak》（2004）记录 Strokes 时代毛糙感加纳什维尔/南方摇滚潜流。《Only by the Night》（2008）是商业拐点：延时吉他、大空间混响、合唱副歌。

《Sex on Fire》的 lead riff 与 Caleb 假声绷紧是主要跨界动作。

body.en:
1999–present core: Caleb (vocals/rhythm), Jared (bass), Nathan (drums), Matthew (lead guitar, joined 2000).

No singer swap across the catalog—the arc is production and songwriting, not personnel churn. Early live sets ran short and loud; post-2008 tours scale delay and arena PA.

Matthew’s lead lines grow from blues bends toward dotted-eighth delay figures.

The Followills is the bar-band name before RCA. The Strokes’ early notice is on the first UK press cycle, before Only by the Night.
body.zh:
1999 至今核心：Caleb（人声/节奏）、Jared（贝斯）、Nathan（鼓）、Matthew（lead 吉他，2000 年加入）。

目录无换主唱——弧线是制作与写歌，非人员流动。早期现场短而响；2008 后巡演放大延时与体育场 PA。

Matthew 的 lead 线从蓝调推弦长到附点八分延时音型。

The Followills 是 RCA 之前的酒吧乐队名。The Strokes 的早期留意写在《Only by the Night》之前的英国报道里。

alt.en: Kings of Leon at Hyde Park

title.en: US stadium indie after UK revival
title.zh: 英国复兴后的美国体育场 indie

body.en:
A US parallel to 2000s UK indie stadium acts—Pixies-style dynamic shifts filtered through Southern rock vocal strain.

Only by the Night’s chart run opened US alt-radio to family-band guitar rock beside large ballads. Later records split critical and commercial reception; 2008 remains the citation year.

The lasting references are radio format and production gloss as much as riff invention.
body.zh:
与 2000 年代英国 indie 体育场乐队的美国平行线——Pixies 式动态切换经南方摇滚人声绷紧过滤。

《Only by the Night》榜跑让美国 alt 电台同时接纳家族乐队吉他摇滚与大型谣曲。后期唱片评论与商业分裂；2008 仍是引用年。

持久参照在电台格式与制作光泽，也在 riff 写法。

Family four; Only by the Night as mainstream peak.

Three brothers plus cousin Matthew. No chair changes in the entry. The 2009 festival break is a live incident, not a lineup change.
